description: Use when connecting an AI assistant or agent to a Didit account through the Didit MCP server (Model Context Protocol), not for backend REST integration code. Covers installing the hosted server in Claude Code, claude.ai, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed or any MCP client; signing in with a Didit console account (OAuth 2.1) or connecting with an application API key; running the local stdio server or self-hosting the HTTP server, with device-code login; toolsets and read-only mode; and having an agent act in the Didit Business Console: workflows, sessions, standalone checks, users, transactions and rules, Travel Rule, lists, cases, webhooks, reports and billing. Covers scopes, roles, confirmations and file inputs.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
